get_character.description: Get a single Dragon Ball character by id. This is the only lookup that carries the character's origin planet and their transformations, both of which the listing actions leave out.

character.name: Goku

parameters.description: Pick a character, or reference one from a previous step by its ID.
parameters.name: character_id

isDestroyed.description: True when the planet has been destroyed.

transformations.description: The character's transformations, empty for a character with none. Only the single-character lookup carries this.

get_character_transformations.description: List every transformation of one character, such as Goku's Super Saiyan forms. The API has no route of its own for these, so this reads them off the character record and hands back just the list, named and counted. Plenty of characters have none, which returns an empty list rather than an error.

list_characters.description: List Dragon Ball characters one page at a time, with each character's own details as the API records them. Set Limit to choose the page size and Page to walk the roster; the result carries the total count, the page numbers either side of this one and a has_more flag, so a workflow can page through the whole cast without guessing where it ends.

search_characters.description: Find characters by name, race, gender or affiliation, in any combination: race Saiyan with affiliation Z Fighter returns every Saiyan fighting on that side. At least one filter is required. A filtered query is not paginated, so this returns every match at once rather than a page of them, and nothing matching returns an empty list rather than an error.

description: Look up Dragon Ball data using the free, keyless Dragon Ball API: page through the characters and the planets, filter characters by name, race, gender or affiliation and planets by name or whether they have been destroyed, and fetch any single record by id along with a character's transformations or a planet's natives. No account or API key required. Disclaimer: this is an independent integration with the community-run Dragon Ball API (dragonball-api.com).
